g.text: Comprehensive PostgreSQL Schema: 15 Entities, Relational Invariants, Cryptographic Audit Chain & Outbox
AUDIT_EVENT rows form an immutable hash chain: curr_hash = SHA256(prev_hash + sequence + payload).
Appends are serialized via PostgreSQL transaction-level advisory locks to eliminate race conditions.
Every TOOL_INVOCATION pins a specific, immutable POLICY_VERSION row. Once published,
a version can never be mutated, ensuring 100% deterministic post-incident auditability.
APPROVAL_REQUEST holds a 1:1 relationship with TOOL_INVOCATION. Edited arguments are encrypted
and bound to arguments_hash; modified calls must pass fresh schema and policy re-validation.
KILL_SWITCH supports GLOBAL_WRITES, AGENT, and TOOL scopes, mirrored into Redis for sub-10ms
interception and immediately canceling affected pending approval requests.
EVENT_PUBLICATION records are written inside the exact same DB transaction as business mutations,
guaranteeing at-least-once event delivery to external subscribers without dual-write hazards.
Data Integrity: Flyway DDL • Strict FK Constraints • JSONB Schemas • Optimistic Locking
